translations.web: He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.
translations.bsb: Then he must take off his garments, put on other clothes, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a ceremonially clean place.
translations.kjv: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.
translations.asv: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.
